title: Scout overlay card
description: One card Scout Desktop's in-game overlay may show: short text the player could read in their own client, with no Riot ID or summoner name. Unknown keys are refused. Zod (overlay-card.schema.ts) and serde (scout-overlay src/card.rs) both hold the shared fixtures in overlay-card.fixtures.json to this file. Whether a proactive card may be shown at all is the overlay's policy, not this schema.

id.description: Stable per card; offering the same id again replaces the card.

ttlSecs.description: Seconds the card stays queued before it expires.
